# Pin file for policy octo-small-1.5 — Linux (and WSL): install **after** Octo's `requirements.txt` (see README §3).
# Windows: use `requirements-vla-octo-small-1.5-windows.txt` instead (do not install Octo's full requirements.txt there).
#
# Python 3.12 note: Octo's requirements.txt pins numpy==1.24.3 and ml_dtypes==0.2.0 (no Py3.12 wheels),
# and uses jax.random.KeyArray (removed in JAX 0.4.24). On Python 3.12 skip requirements.txt entirely;
# install numpy>=1.26, ml_dtypes>=0.4, flax, tensorflow, tensorflow_datasets, tf_keras, optax, distrax,
# dlimp (--no-deps, git+https://github.com/kvablack/dlimp.git), and patch octo/utils/typing.py
# (jax.random.KeyArray → jax.Array). See colab/m1_maniskill_octo.ipynb for the full working recipe.
jax>=0.4
python-dotenv>=1.0
fastapi>=0.100
uvicorn[standard]>=0.23
python-multipart>=0.0.6
